verdict.rationale: Auth0 ships an official, first-party MCP server, documented in its own docs and published in its GitHub org. It lets AI agents like Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf connect to an Auth0 tenant over OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization. Agents can then create applications, manage users, deploy Actions, and debug logs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
